hypothesis: Independent calibration, asymmetric false-negative penalty and prefix-local role-availability signals can replace W-F15's harmful early negative stops while obtaining at least 15% recurrent-step savings on unseen 7-8-hop ordered typed graphs, outperforming a separately risk-calibrated confidence heuristic.

per_graph_variants: negative after necessary edge role mutation
protocol.training: 8-parameter prefix logistic risk head, 220 Adam epochs lr .06, false safe cost 22x positive safe gain; labels from TRAIN-only final correctness and trajectory stability
protocol.features: F15 6 current-prefix activation/score/budget features plus O(12) next public role compatibility max and mean; no future model rollout or oracle at inference
protocol.calibration: entirely distinct calibration seeds, one-sided Wilson z=1.645 upper FNR bound <=.05 and calibration accuracy >=.995; threshold selected to maximize recurrent-step savings; no-stop threshold in grid
comparators: calibration-safe confidence rule using SAME calibration requirements

limitations.metrics_measure: recurrent steps saved, not latency or total compute
